Monster ^FF0000{0}^000000 for the
Single Monster Race.
The start of the race
will be announced soon,
so please wait. Thank you.

你已选择^FF0000{0}^000000号魔物参加单魔物赛跑。
比赛开始时会发布通知，请稍等。
谢谢。

[Ticket Helper]
You've chosen Monster {0}?
Alright then, please wait
until the start of the race is
announced. If the monster you
picked wins, then please use this ticket to redeem your prize.

[票务助手]
你选的是{0}号魔物，对吧？
好的，请等候比赛开始的通知。
如果你选的魔物获胜，就凭这张票来领奖。

scripts.text:
[Ticket Helper]
I'm sorry, but a Monster
Race is now in progress.
If you'd like to participate, then please wait for the next race.
scripts.translation:
[票务助手]
抱歉，魔物赛跑正在进行中。
想参加的话，请等下一场比赛。

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
I'm sorry, but I can't
reward you with any medals
until you make more space
available in your Inventory.
scripts.translation:
[勋章发放员]
抱歉，你得先在物品栏里腾出些空间，我才能给你发奖牌。

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
Hello there~
If you've wagered on the
winning monster in a recent
race, then you can exchange
your game ticket here for
some Prize Medals.
scripts.translation:
[勋章发放员]
你好~
如果你押中了刚才那场比赛的获胜魔物，就可以在这里凭比赛票兑换神奇的奖牌。

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
Please remember that you can
only exchange winning Game
Tickets for Prize Medals right
after the race finishes. Prize
Medals may be given to Wayne
in Hugel in exchange for items.
scripts.translation:
[勋章发放员]
记住，只有在比赛刚结束时，才能凭中奖的比赛票兑换神奇的奖牌。
奖牌可以交给毁葛的韦恩，用来兑换物品。

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
Oh, congratulations, you
have a winning ticket for
a Single Monster Race! So 
would you like to exchange your
Racing Ticket for Prize Medals?
scripts.translation:
[勋章发放员]
哦，恭喜！
你这张票押中了单魔物赛跑的获胜魔物！
要把赛跑票兑换成神奇的奖牌吗？

scripts.text: Yes, please.
scripts.translation: 好的，请兑换

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
Um, are you sure? You 
can only exchange a winning
Racing Ticket for Prize Medals
for a short time after the race. If you made a mistake, you
should ask me again quickly.
scripts.translation:
[勋章发放员]
你确定吗？
中奖的赛跑票只有在比赛结束后的一小段时间内，才能兑换神奇的奖牌。
如果刚才选错了，就赶紧再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
Let me see your ticket...
Oh! Congratulations, you
won! May I have your name?
scripts.translation:
[勋章发放员]
让我看看你的票...
哦！恭喜，你赢了！
请问你叫什么名字？

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
Ah, {0}.
You can exchange this
ticket for a Prize Medal by
entering your ticket exchange
number now. Your ticket
exchange number is ^FF0000{1}^000000.
scripts.translation:
[勋章发放员]
啊，{0}。
现在输入兑换号码，就能凭这张票领取一枚神奇的奖牌。
你的兑换号码是^FF0000{1}^000000。

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
Oh? You don't want
to exchange your
winning ticket?
scripts.translation:
[勋章发放员]
哦？
你不想兑换这张中奖的票吗？

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
Thank you! You entered
the correct number...
Everything seems to
be in order. Alright!
scripts.translation:
[勋章发放员]
谢谢！
你输入的号码正确...
一切都没问题。
好！

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
Now please accept your
Prize Medals! You can
exchange these with
Wayne in Hugel for some
interesting items. Thank you~
scripts.translation:
[勋章发放员]
请收下你的神奇的奖牌！
拿这些奖牌去找毁葛的韦恩，就能兑换一些有趣的物品。
谢谢~

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
I'm sorry, but it seems
that you entered the
incorrect ticket number.
Would you mind coming
back again in a while?
scripts.translation:
[勋章发放员]
抱歉，你输入的票号好像不对。
请过一会儿再来，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
What's this...?
I think there's a problem...
Did you enter your name
incorrectly? Please check
your name, and then try again.
scripts.translation:

怎么回事...？

你是不是输错了名字？
请核对一下名字，再试一次。

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
You may not have wagered
on the winning monster in
the last race, but I hope that
you get lucky next time~
scripts.translation:
[勋章发放员]
看来你没押中上一场比赛的获胜魔物，希望你下次能有好运气~

scripts.text:
[Exit Guide]
If you have a winning Racing
Ticket, please make sure that
you redeem it for Prize Medals
now. All Racing Tickets become
void once the next race begins.
scripts.translation:
[出口向导]
如果你有中奖的赛跑票，务必现在就兑换成神奇的奖牌。
下一场比赛一开始，所有赛跑票都会失效。

scripts.text:
[Exit Guide]
If you wish to leave
the arena, then I can guide
you outside. Would you like
to leave the arena right now?
scripts.translation:
[出口向导]
想离开竞技场的话，我可以带你出去。
你现在要离开吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Exit Guide]
Alright, then.
Just let me know
whenever you're
ready to leave.
scripts.translation:
[出口向导]
好的。
准备离开时，随时告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Exit Guide]
Thank you for
your patronage, and
I hope that you come
visit us again soon~
scripts.translation:
[出口向导]
感谢惠顾，希望你很快再来玩~

scripts.text:
[Exit Guide]
In accordance with our
policies, I must take your
Racing Ticket before you leave.
Thank you for your patronage,
and I hope you enjoy your time
here in the Monster Race Arena.
scripts.translation:
[出口向导]
按照规定，你离开前，我必须收回你的赛跑票。
感谢惠顾，希望你在魔物赛跑竞技场玩得开心。

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
Welcome to the biggest
attraction in Hugel, the
Monster Race Arena.
How may I help you today?
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾勒伯德]
欢迎来到毁葛最受欢迎的景点——魔物赛跑竞技场。
有什么我能帮你的吗？

scripts.text: Monster Race Info
scripts.translation: 魔物赛跑介绍

scripts.text: Enter Monster Race
scripts.translation: 进入赛场

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
Monster Races originated from
simple children's games in which
Cute Pets would race against each other. This grew into an adult
pastime that is so popular, we've built a racing arena in Hugel.
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾勒伯德]
魔物赛跑最初只是孩子们让宠物互相赛跑的小游戏，后来逐渐成了大人们的消遣。
这项活动实在太受欢迎，所以我们在毁葛建了这座赛跑竞技场。

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
Our Monster Race Arena hosts
two types of monster races. First, we have the Single Monster Race,
in which those that wagered on the 1st place monster are rewarded.
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾勒伯德]
我们这里有两种魔物赛跑。
第一种是单魔物赛跑，押中冠军魔物就能获得奖励。

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
Then, we have the Dual Monster
Race in which the house odds and rewards are greater than in Single
Monster Races: you must wager on 2 monsters, and they must place in
1st and 2nd for you to win.
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾勒伯德]
另一种是双魔物赛跑，赔率和奖励都比单魔物赛跑高。
你要押两只魔物，只有它们包揽第一、第二名，你才能赢。

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
Although a small entrance
fee is required, we only use
the money to give rewards to
participants and maintain this
arena. Therefore, we're not
profiting from this enterprise.
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾勒伯德]
虽然我们收取少量入场费，但这些钱只用于发放奖励和维护竞技场。
所以，我们并不靠这项活动赚钱。

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
Also, we prohibit others
from making personal bets
and wagers, using items and
zeny, based on the outcomes
of these races. That kind of
gambling is illegal here...
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾勒伯德]
另外，我们禁止玩家根据比赛结果，用物品或Zeny私下下注。
这种赌博在这里是违法的...

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
Once you enter the Race Arena, you will receive a Racing Ticket.
Keep in mind that winning Racing Tickets can only be exchanged for
Prize Medals during a 5 minute window after the end of the race.
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾勒伯德]
进入赛场后，你会拿到一张赛跑票。
记住，中奖的赛跑票只能在比赛结束后的5分钟内兑换神奇的奖牌。

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
The entrance fee for all races
in the Monster Race Arena is
2,000 zeny. If you'd like to wager on a Dual Monster Race, then
please ask my brother Erenes,
and he will help you.
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾勒伯德]
这里所有魔物赛跑的入场费都是2,000 Zeny。
想参加双魔物赛跑，就找我的兄弟艾雷内斯，他会帮你。

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
Otherwise, I'll help get you
started if you're interested
in a Single Monster Race.
Would you like wager on
a Single Monster Race?
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾勒伯德]
如果你想参加单魔物赛跑，我可以帮你安排。
要参加单魔物赛跑吗？

scripts.text: Yes, please.
scripts.translation: 好的，请安排

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
Very well. I hope that
you enjoy your time here
in the Monster Race Arena~
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾勒伯德]
好的，希望你在魔物赛跑竞技场玩得尽兴~

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
Oh, wow. You're carrying
an awful lot of stuff... Yeah,
you better put some of it away
in Kafra Storage or something.
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾勒伯德]
哇，你带的东西可真多...
最好先把一些东西存到卡普拉仓库之类的地方。

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
I'm sorry, but you
don't have enough
money to pay the
2,000 zeny entrance fee.
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾勒伯德]
抱歉，你的钱不够支付2,000 Zeny的入场费。

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
Hm? What are you doing
with an expired Racing Ticket?
Well, I better get rid of it for you before it can get mixed up
with your new Racing Ticket.
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾勒伯德]
嗯？
你怎么还留着过期的赛跑票？
我帮你处理掉吧，免得和新票弄混了。

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
I'm sorry, but you
don't have enough
money to pay the
2,000 zeny entrance fee.
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾勒伯德]
抱歉，你的钱不够支付2,000 Zeny的入场费。

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
Alright, I think you
should be all set. I hope
that you enjoy the race~
Let me guide you inside
the Monster Race Arena now.
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾勒伯德]
好，一切都准备好了。
希望你看比赛看得开心~
现在我带你进入魔物赛跑竞技场。

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
Thanks, I hope that
you enjoy this race.
Let me guide you now
to the Monster Race Arena.
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾勒伯德]
谢谢，希望你看比赛看得开心。
现在我带你进入魔物赛跑竞技场。

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
We're still finishing our
preparations for the next
Single Monster Race, so
we ask that you please
wait a little while longer...
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾勒伯德]
下一场单魔物赛跑还在做最后的准备，请再稍等一会儿...

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
Right now, a Monster Race
is in progress. It's too late to place a wager, but if you'd like
to watch, the fee is 500 zeny
for spectators. Would you like to enter the Monster Race Arena?
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾勒伯德]
魔物赛跑正在进行，现在已经不能下注了。
不过，你可以花500 Zeny入场观赛。
要进入魔物赛跑竞技场吗？

scripts.text: Enter
scripts.translation: 进入

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
Alright, then. If you'd like
to wager on a monster
race, please wait for the
current race to finish. I hope
that you enjoy your time here
in the Monster Race Arena~
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾勒伯德]
好的。
想下注的话，请等这场比赛结束。
希望你在魔物赛跑竞技场玩得尽兴~

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
Thank you~
I hope you enjoy
watching this race!
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾勒伯德]
谢谢~
祝你观赛愉快！

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
I'm sorry, but you don't
have enough money to pay
the 500 zeny spectator fee.
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾勒伯德]
抱歉，你的钱不够支付500 Zeny的观赛费。

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
I'm sorry, but a monster
race has just ended, so we're
having the 5 minute period in
which the winners can claim
their Prize Medals. The gate
will open soon, so please wait.
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾勒伯德]
抱歉，比赛刚结束，现在是5分钟的领奖时间，获胜者可以领取神奇的奖牌。
大门很快就会开放，请稍等。

谢谢，祝你在魔物赛跑竞技场玩得开心。

scripts.text:
[Eckar Erenes]
Welcome to the
Monster Race Arena,
the pride and joy of
the village of Hugel!
How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾雷内斯]
欢迎来到魔物赛跑竞技场，这里可是毁葛村的骄傲！
有什么我能帮你的吗？

scripts.text: Monster Race Info
scripts.translation: 魔物赛跑介绍

scripts.text: Enter Monster Race
scripts.translation: 进入赛场

scripts.text:
[Eckar Erenes]
Monster Races originated from
simple children's games in which
Cute Pets would race against each other. This grew into an adult
pastime that is so popular, we've built a racing arena in Hugel.
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾雷内斯]
魔物赛跑最初只是孩子们让宠物互相赛跑的小游戏，后来逐渐成了大人们的消遣。
这项活动实在太受欢迎，所以我们在毁葛建了这座赛跑竞技场。

scripts.text:
[Eckar Erenes]
Our Monster Race Arena hosts
two types of monster races. First, we have the Single Monster Race,
in which those that wagered on the 1st place monster are rewarded.
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾雷内斯]
我们这里有两种魔物赛跑。
第一种是单魔物赛跑，押中冠军魔物就能获得奖励。

scripts.text:
[Eckar Erenes]
Then, we have the Dual Monster
Race in which the house odds and rewards are greater than in Single
Monster Races: you must wager on 2 monsters, and they must place in
1st and 2nd for you to win.
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾雷内斯]
另一种是双魔物赛跑，赔率和奖励都比单魔物赛跑高。
你要押两只魔物，只有它们包揽第一、第二名，你才能赢。

scripts.text:
[Eckar Erenes]
Although a small entrance
fee is required, we only use
the money to give rewards to
participants and maintain this
arena. Therefore, we're not
profiting from this enterprise.
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾雷内斯]
虽然我们收取少量入场费，但这些钱只用于发放奖励和维护竞技场。
所以，我们并不靠这项活动赚钱。

scripts.text:
[Eckar Erenes]
Also, we prohibit others
from making personal bets
and wagers, using items and
zeny, based on the outcomes
of these races. That kind of
gambling is illegal here...
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾雷内斯]
另外，我们禁止玩家根据比赛结果，用物品或Zeny私下下注。
这种赌博在这里是违法的...

scripts.text:
[Eckar Erenes]
Once you enter the Race Arena, you will receive a Racing Ticket.
Keep in mind that winning Racing Tickets can only be exchanged for
Prize Medals during a 5 minute window after the end of the race.
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾雷内斯]
进入赛场后，你会拿到一张赛跑票。
记住，中奖的赛跑票只能在比赛结束后的5分钟内兑换神奇的奖牌。

scripts.text:
[Eckar Erenes]
The entrance fee for all races
in the Monster Race Arena is
2,000 zeny. If you'd like to wager on a Single Monster Race,
then please ask my brother
Ellebird to help you.
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾雷内斯]
这里所有魔物赛跑的入场费都是2,000 Zeny。
想参加单魔物赛跑，就找我的兄弟艾勒伯德帮忙。

scripts.text:
[Eckar Erenes]
Otherwise, I'll help get you
started if you're interested
in a Dual Monster Race.
Would you like to wager
on a Dual Monster Race?
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾雷内斯]
如果你想参加双魔物赛跑，我可以帮你安排。
要参加双魔物赛跑吗？

scripts.text: Yes, please.
scripts.translation: 好的，请安排

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢

scripts.text:
[Eckar Erenes]
Very well. I hope that
you enjoy your time here
in the Monster Race Arena~
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾雷内斯]
好的，希望你在魔物赛跑竞技场玩得尽兴~

scripts.text:
[Eckar Erenes]
Hmm... You're toting
too many things with you
right now. You better put
some of your stuff away in
Kafra Storage before you can
wager on any monster races...
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾雷内斯]
嗯...你带的东西太多了。
先把一些东西存到卡普拉仓库，再来下注吧...

scripts.text:
[Eckar Erenes]
I'm sorry, but you
don't have enough
money to pay the
2,000 zeny entrance fee.
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾雷内斯]
抱歉，你的钱不够支付2,000 Zeny的入场费。

scripts.text:
[Eckar Erenes]
Hm? What are you doing
with an expired Racing Ticket?
Well, I better get rid of it for you before it can get mixed up
with your new Racing Ticket.
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾雷内斯]
嗯？
你怎么还留着过期的赛跑票？
我帮你处理掉吧，免得和新票弄混了。

scripts.text:
[Eckar Erenes]
Alright, I think you
should be all set. I hope
that you enjoy the race~
Let me guide you inside
the Monster Race Arena now.
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾雷内斯]
好，一切都准备好了。
希望你看比赛看得开心~
现在我带你进入魔物赛跑竞技场。

scripts.text:
[Eckar Erenes]
We're still finishing our
preparations for the next
Double Monster Race, so
we ask that you please
wait a little while longer...
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾雷内斯]
下一场双魔物赛跑还在做最后的准备，请再稍等一会儿...

scripts.text:
[Eckar Erenes]
Thanks, I hope that
you enjoy this race.
Let me guide you now
to the Monster Race Arena.
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾雷内斯]
谢谢，希望你看比赛看得开心。
现在我带你进入魔物赛跑竞技场。

scripts.text:
[Eckar Erenes]
We're still finishing our
preparations for the next
Double Monster Race, so
we ask that you please
wait a little while longer...
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾雷内斯]
下一场双魔物赛跑还在做最后的准备，请再稍等一会儿...

scripts.text:
[Eckar Erenes]
Right now, a Monster Race
is in progress. It's too late to place a wager, but if you'd like
to watch, the fee is 500 zeny
for spectators. Would you like to enter the Monster Race Arena?
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾雷内斯]
魔物赛跑正在进行，现在已经不能下注了。
不过，你可以花500 Zeny入场观赛。
要进入魔物赛跑竞技场吗？

scripts.text: Enter
scripts.translation: 进入

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Eckar Erenes]
Alright, then. If you'd like
to wager on a monster
race, please wait for the
current race to finish. I hope
that you enjoy your time here
in the Monster Race Arena~
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾雷内斯]
好的。
想下注的话，请等这场比赛结束。
希望你在魔物赛跑竞技场玩得尽兴~

scripts.text:
[Eckar Erenes]
Thank you~
I hope you enjoy
watching this race!
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾雷内斯]
谢谢~
祝你观赛愉快！

scripts.text:
[Eckar Erenes]
I'm sorry, but you don't
have enough money to pay
the 500 zeny spectator fee.
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾雷内斯]
抱歉，你的钱不够支付500 Zeny的观赛费。

scripts.text:
[Eckar Erenes]
I'm sorry, but a monster
race has just ended, so we're
having the 5 minute period in
which the winners can claim
their Prize Medals. The gate
will open soon, so please wait.
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾雷内斯]
抱歉，比赛刚结束，现在是5分钟的领奖时间，获胜者可以领取神奇的奖牌。
大门很快就会开放，请稍等。

scripts.text:
[Ticket Helper]
Welcome to the
Monster Race Arena.
If you'd like to participate
in the ^3131FFDouble Monster Race^000000,
then please select 1 out of
the 6 monsters from the list.
scripts.translation:
[票务助手]
欢迎来到魔物赛跑竞技场。
想参加^3131FF双魔物赛跑^000000的话，请从列表中的6只魔物里选出1只。

scripts.text:
[Ticket Helper]
Wait, wait...
I can't give you
anything right now.
You're carrying way
too many things...
scripts.translation:
[票务助手]
等等，等等...
你带的东西太多了，我现在没法再给你任何东西...

scripts.text:
[Ticket Helper]
Hello there!
Interested in wagering on
the Dual Monster Race?
I'm here to help you if you've
got any questions, or if you
want to place your wager.
scripts.translation:
[票务助手]
你好！
有兴趣参加双魔物赛跑吗？
有什么问题，或是想下注，都可以找我。

scripts.text: Check Monster Status
scripts.translation: 查看魔物状态

scripts.text: Wager on Race
scripts.translation: 下注

scripts.text: Monster Race?
scripts.translation: 魔物赛跑？

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Ticket Helper]
Alright, please choose which
two monsters that you think
will win 1st and 2nd place.
If both your monsters come
in 1st and 2nd, in any order,
you'll win the wager.
scripts.translation:
[票务助手]
好，请选出你认为会获得第一、第二名的两只魔物。
只要这两只魔物包揽前两名，无论顺序如何，都算你赢。

scripts.text:
[Ticket Helper]
Now, please tell me
your first choice for one
of the monsters that
will win this race.
scripts.translation:
[票务助手]
先告诉我，你认为会赢的第一只魔物是哪只。

scripts.text:
[Ticket Helper]
You've chosen
^0000FFMonster {0}^000000, {1}
{2}.
Are you sure you want
to choose this monster?
scripts.translation:
[票务助手]
你选的是^0000FF{0}号魔物^000000，{1}{2}。
确定要选这只魔物吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Ticket Helper]
You have canceled
your wager. Okay,
I understand. Perhaps
you'd feel more comfortable
checking the monsters first?
scripts.translation:
[票务助手]
你取消了下注。
好的，我明白了。
也许先看看魔物的状态，你会更有把握？

scripts.text:
[Ticket Helper]
Now, please make
your second choice
for the monster that
you think will place
1st or 2nd in this race.
scripts.translation:
[票务助手]
现在选第二只魔物吧，选一只你认为会获得第一名或第二名的。

scripts.text:
[Ticket Helper]
You've wagered on
^0000FFMonster {0}^000000 and ^0000FFMonster {1}^000000
to win this race. Good luck!
I really hope that the odds
work out in your favor~
scripts.translation:
[票务助手]
你押的是^0000FF{0}号魔物^000000和^0000FF{1}号魔物^000000。
祝你好运！
真希望这次运气站在你这边~

scripts.text:
[Ticket Helper]
I'm very sorry, but a
monster race is underway.
Please wait, and then place
your wager for the next race.
scripts.translation:
[票务助手]
抱歉，魔物赛跑正在进行中。
请等比赛结束，再为下一场比赛下注。

Then, we have the Dual Monster

are equally rewarded. The house
odds and wager rewards are greater in Dual Races than Single Races.
scripts.translation:

另一种是双魔物赛跑，押中第一、第二名魔物的玩家都能获得同等奖励。
双魔物赛跑的赔率和下注奖励都比单魔物赛跑高。

scripts.text:

Although a small entrance
fee is required, we only use
the money to give rewards to
participants and maintain this
arena. Therefore, we're not
profiting from this enterprise.
scripts.translation:
[票务助手]
虽然我们收取少量入场费，但这些钱只用于发放奖励和维护竞技场。
所以，我们并不靠这项活动赚钱。

scripts.text:

Also, we prohibit others

进入赛场后，你会拿到一张赛跑票。

scripts.text:
[Ticket Helper]
You're already here
inside the Monster Race
Arena, so you may as well
try placing a wager. It's
more fun than you'd think~
scripts.translation:
[票务助手]
既然都进了魔物赛跑竞技场，不妨试着下注吧。
比你想象的还要有趣哦~

scripts.text:
[Ticket Helper]
You have canceled
your wager. Okay,
I understand. Perhaps
you'd feel more comfortable
checking the monsters first?
scripts.translation:
[票务助手]
你取消了下注。
好的，我明白了。
也许先看看魔物的状态，你会更有把握？

scripts.text:

You've wagered on
^0000FFMonster {0}^000000 and ^0000FFMonster {1}^000000
for this Dual Monster Race.
scripts.translation:
[票务助手]
这场双魔物赛跑，你押的是^0000FF{0}号魔物^000000和^0000FF{1}号魔物^000000。

scripts.text:
[Ticket Helper]
The start of the race will be
announced through a broadcast.
You can refer to your Mini-Map
to track the monsters' race
positions. Thank you, and
have a good time!
scripts.translation:
[票务助手]
比赛开始时会有广播通知。
你可以查看小地图，了解魔物在赛道上的位置。
谢谢，祝你玩得开心！

scripts.text:

How can I help you?

有什么我能帮你的吗？

scripts.translation: 魔物赛跑介绍

scripts.translation:
[游戏向导]
下注前，先去找票务助手领取免费的赛跑票。

scripts.translation:

5分钟一过，你就会被传送到外面，我们也会立刻开始筹备下一场比赛。

scripts.text:

your free Racing Ticket,
then please visit the Ticket
Helper. There, I've just marked
his location on your Mini-Map.
scripts.translation:

scripts.translation:

reward you with any medals
until you make more space
available in your Inventory.
scripts.translation:
[勋章发放员]
抱歉，你得先在物品栏里腾出些空间，我才能给你发奖牌。

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
Hello there~
If you've wagered on the
winning monster in a recent
race, then you can exchange
your game ticket here for
some Prize Medals.
scripts.translation:
[勋章发放员]
你好~
如果你押中了刚才那场比赛的获胜魔物，就可以在这里凭比赛票兑换神奇的奖牌。

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]

only exchange winning Game
Tickets for Prize Medals right
after the race finishes. Prize
Medals may be given to Wayne
in Hugel in exchange for items.
scripts.translation:

记住，只有在比赛刚结束时，才能凭中奖的比赛票兑换神奇的奖牌。

in Hugel in exchange for items.
scripts.translation:
[勋章发放员]
记住，只有在比赛刚结束时，才能凭中奖的比赛票兑换神奇的奖牌。
奖牌可以交给毁葛的韦恩，用来兑换物品。

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
Congratulations! It's really
difficult to guess the winners
of a Dual Monster Race, so you
must be really lucky! Would you
like to exchange your winning
Racing Ticket for Prize Medals?
scripts.translation:
[勋章发放员]
恭喜！
双魔物赛跑的获胜魔物可不好猜，你真是太幸运了！
要把中奖的赛跑票兑换成神奇的奖牌吗？

scripts.text: Yes, please.
scripts.translation: 好的，请兑换

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
Okay, everything looks good,
so here's your Prize Medals~
If you want to trade these
medals for items, please
visit Wayne in Hugel. We hope
you enjoyed the Monster Race~
scripts.translation:
[勋章发放员]
好，一切都没问题，这是你的神奇的奖牌~
想用奖牌兑换物品，就去找毁葛的韦恩吧。
希望你看魔物赛跑看得开心~

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
Um, are you sure? You 
can only exchange a winning
Racing Ticket for Prize Medals
for a short time after the race. If you made a mistake, you
should ask me again quickly.
scripts.translation:
[勋章发放员]
你确定吗？
中奖的赛跑票只有在比赛结束后的一小段时间内，才能兑换神奇的奖牌。
如果刚才选错了，就赶紧再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
Well, better luck next time...
Although you can't always
be lucky, it's always fun to
wager on the monster races!
scripts.translation:
[勋章发放员]
希望你下次有好运气...
虽说不可能次次都赢，但给魔物赛跑下注，总是很有趣的！

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
Thanks for visiting the
Monster Race Arena, and
I hope you enjoy your time
here. I'll see you next time~
scripts.translation:
[勋章发放员]
感谢光临魔物赛跑竞技场，祝你在这里玩得开心。
下次见~

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
You may not have wagered
on the winning monster in
the last race, but I hope that
you get lucky next time~
scripts.translation:
[勋章发放员]
看来你没押中上一场比赛的获胜魔物，希望你下次能有好运气~

scripts.text:
[Exit Guide]
If you have a winning Racing
Ticket, please make sure that
you redeem it for Prize Medals
now. All Racing Tickets become
void once the next race begins.
scripts.translation:
[出口向导]
如果你有中奖的赛跑票，务必现在就兑换成神奇的奖牌。
下一场比赛一开始，所有赛跑票都会失效。

scripts.text:
[Exit Guide]
If you wish to leave
the arena, then I can guide
you outside. Would you like
to leave the arena right now?
scripts.translation:
[出口向导]
想离开竞技场的话，我可以带你出去。
你现在要离开吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Exit Guide]
Alright, then.
Just let me know
whenever you're
ready to leave.
scripts.translation:
[出口向导]
好的。
准备离开时，随时告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Exit Guide]
Thank you for
your patronage, and
I hope that you come
visit us again soon~
scripts.translation:
[出口向导]
感谢惠顾，希望你很快再来玩~

scripts.text:
[Exit Guide]
In accordance with our
policies, I must take your
Racing Ticket before you leave.
Thank you for your patronage,
and I hope you enjoy your time
here in the Monster Race Arena.
scripts.translation:
[出口向导]
按照规定，你离开前，我必须收回你的赛跑票。
感谢惠顾，希望你在魔物赛跑竞技场玩得开心。

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Curses! We need to deliver
what our customers ordered,
but we've been making nothing
but shipshod products! If we
only had that metal, we could
pump up our product quality!
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
该死！
顾客订的货还等着交付，可我们做出来的全是劣质品！
要是有那种金属，就能提升产品质量了！

scripts.text: What metal are you talking about?
scripts.translation: 你说的是哪种金属

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
There's a small village
at the outskirts of the
Schwarzwald Republic that
gives these special medals
that are made of this metal
which we desperately need...
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国边境有个小村庄，会发放一种特殊奖牌。
那些奖牌就是用我们急需的金属做的...

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
We've sent one of our best
guildsmen to get some of those
medals for us, but he hasn't
reported back to us quite yet.
I'm getting pretty anxious...
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
我们派了一位最出色的公会成员去收集奖牌，可他到现在还没回来汇报。
我越来越着急了...

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
I mean, we need a whole
lot of that metal to fill out
our orders and finish our
manufacturing research,
but so far, none of us have
been able to get any medals...
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
完成订单和制造研究，都需要大量那种金属。
可到现在，我们谁都没弄到奖牌...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh! Are you talking
about the medals that
they give as rewards in
the Monster Race Arena?
I have some of those.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦！
你说的是魔物赛跑竞技场发放的奖励奖牌吗？
我正好有一些。

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Huh? Show them to me...
Yes! That's exactly what
we need! Would you please
donate your medals so that we
can finally make some quality
products for our customers?
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
啊？
给我看看...
没错！
这正是我们需要的！
能请你捐出这些奖牌吗？
有了它们，我们终于能为顾客做出优质产品了！

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
If you happen to obtain any
medals from the Monster
Race Arena in Hugel, then
please bring some of them
to me. I'll be sure to repay
you for your kindness...
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
如果你在毁葛的魔物赛跑竞技场拿到了奖牌，请带一些给我。
我一定会报答你的好意...

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Oh, how have you been?
Thank you so much for
donating so many medals,
they've been helpful in my
research. Still, I need more
and more of them everyday...
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
哦，最近怎么样？
非常感谢你捐了那么多奖牌，对我的研究帮助很大。
不过，我每天都还需要更多奖牌...

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
The other Blacksmith
Guildsmen are doing their
best to collect Prize Medals
in Hugel, but they keep failing
to win them! If you have any
medals, then may I have some?
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
其他铁匠公会成员都在毁葛努力收集神奇的奖牌，可就是赢不到！
如果你有奖牌，能给我一些吗？

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
If you happen to obtain any
medals from the Monster
Race Arena in Hugel, then
please bring some of them
to me. I'll be sure to repay
you for your kindness...
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
如果你在毁葛的魔物赛跑竞技场拿到了奖牌，请带一些给我。
我一定会报答你的好意...

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Goodness, you're carrying
so many things with you!
You'd better put some of
it away in Kafra Storage
before you're overwhelmed
by the bulk of your items!
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
天哪，你带了这么多东西！
赶紧把一些东西存到卡普拉仓库吧，别让这些物品把你压垮了！

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Ah, welcome back! I've finally
made a breakthrough in my
metal research! Look, I've
developed this Glittering
Jacket! It's lightweight and
very durable, you see?
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
啊，欢迎回来！
我的金属研究终于有突破了！
看，这是我研发的秘衣 恶德！
又轻便又耐用，看到了吗？

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
I wouldn't be able to have
completed this without your
help. Now, would you like to
receive this Glittering Jacket
as my way of repaying you?
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
没有你的帮助，我不可能完成这项研究。
愿意收下这件秘衣 恶德，作为我的回报吗？

scripts.text: Accept
scripts.translation: 接受

scripts.text: Wait for Further Development
scripts.translation: 等待后续研发

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Ah, I see. You'd rather wait
until we develop something
more to your liking. In that
case, would you please donate
more medals to my research?
We're always low on them...
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
啊，我明白了。
你想等我们研发出更合心意的东西。
那能再捐些奖牌，支持我的研究吗？
我们总是缺奖牌...

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Oh, you're back!
Thanks to all the medals
that you've donated, I'm now
able to manufacture a set
of slotted armor imbued
with a property of your choice.
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
哦，你回来了！
多亏你捐的奖牌，我现在能制造带插槽的防具了，还可以附上你选择的属性。

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
If you'd like, I can repay you
now by creating a set of slotted elemental armor for you, or we
can wait for you to donate more
medals until I can develop
something else for you.
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
如果你愿意，我现在就能打造带插槽的属性防具，作为回报。
你也可以继续捐奖牌，等我研发出别的东西。

scripts.text: Accept Armor
scripts.translation: 接受防具

scripts.text: Can I have something else?
scripts.translation: 能换点别的吗

scripts.text: Wait for Further Development
scripts.translation: 等待后续研发

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
I can manufacture one set of
slotted Armor imbued with the
Fire, Earth, Wind, or Water
property. Which property would
you like your armor to have?
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
我能制造带插槽的防具，附上火、地、风或水属性。
你想要哪种属性？

scripts.text: Fire Property
scripts.translation: 火属性

scripts.text: Earth Property
scripts.translation: 地属性

scripts.text: Wind Property
scripts.translation: 风属性

scripts.text: Water Property
scripts.translation: 水属性

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Something else...?
Oh, you must mean
the Glittering Jacket that
I developed earlier. After
all, I have any other items
to offer you for now...
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
别的东西...？
哦，你指的应该是我之前研发的秘衣 恶德吧。
毕竟，我现在也没别的东西可以给你了...

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Ah, I see. You'd rather wait
until we develop something
more to your liking. In that
case, would you please donate
more medals to my research?
We're always low on them...
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
啊，我明白了。
你想等我们研发出更合心意的东西。
那能再捐些奖牌，支持我的研究吗？
我们总是缺奖牌...

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
The other Blacksmith
Guildsmen are doing their
best to collect Prize Medals
in Hugel, but they keep failing
to win them! If you have any
medals, then may I have some?
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
其他铁匠公会成员都在毁葛努力收集神奇的奖牌，可就是赢不到！
如果你有奖牌，能给我一些吗？

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
If you happen to obtain any
medals from the Monster
Race Arena in Hugel, then
please bring some of them
to me. I'll be sure to repay
you for your kindness...
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
如果你在毁葛的魔物赛跑竞技场拿到了奖牌，请带一些给我。
我一定会报答你的好意...

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Ah, you're back! I've
extracted all the metal
from the medals you've
given me, and I think I have
enough to create a Level 4
Weapon. Isn't that incredible?
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
啊，你回来了！
你给我的奖牌，我已经把其中的金属都提取出来了。
这些材料应该够打造一把4级武器了。
是不是很厉害？

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
If you like, I can create
one of these weapons for you
as my way of repaying you for
your help. What do you think?
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
如果你愿意，我可以为你打造其中一把武器，报答你的帮助。
你觉得怎么样？

scripts.text: Yes, I want a Level 4 Weapon.
scripts.translation: 我要一把4级武器

scripts.text: Can I have something else?
scripts.translation: 能换点别的吗

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Something else?
Oh, alright then, would
you like to have a Glittering
Jacket, or a set of slotted
elemental Armor? Please go
ahead and make your choice~
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
想要别的东西？
好吧，那你要秘衣 恶德，还是带插槽的属性防具？
选一个吧~

scripts.text: Glittering Jacket
scripts.translation: 秘衣 恶德

scripts.text: Fire Property Armor
scripts.translation: 火属性防具

scripts.text: Earth Property Armor
scripts.translation: 地属性防具

scripts.text: Wind Property Armor
scripts.translation: 风属性防具

scripts.text: Water Property Armor
scripts.translation: 水属性防具

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
So you'd like to have a
{0}? Please choose
which Level 4 Weapon
that you want me to create.
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
你想要{0}，对吧？
请选择你想让我打造的4级武器。

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: Sure
scripts.translation: 好

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Oh, alright...
Still, I really need
those medals, so if you
change your mind, please
come back as soon as you can.
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
哦，好吧...
不过，我真的很需要那些奖牌。
要是改变主意了，请尽快回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Oh, thank you so much!
I can use the metal in those
medals to produce some high
quality products. Now, how
shall I repay you for giving me
some of your Prize Medals?
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
哦，太感谢了！
用这些奖牌里的金属，我就能做出优质产品了。
你给了我这么多神奇的奖牌，该怎么报答你呢？

scripts.text: Base Experience
scripts.translation: 基础经验值

scripts.text: Job Experience
scripts.translation: 职业经验值

scripts.text: No, I'm just glad to help.
scripts.translation: 不用，我很乐意帮忙

scripts.text: How's your research progressing?
scripts.translation: 研究进展如何

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
You just want to improve
yourself, huh? Well, I dunno
if you want to get stronger,
smarter, or faster, but I can
coach you on some visualization if you like. Now, relax with me~
physical development.
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
你只是想提升自己，是吧？
嗯，不知道你是想更强壮、更聪明，还是更敏捷，不过我可以指导你做些意象训练。
现在，跟着我放松~
开发身体潜能。

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Focus... and believe.
Believe that you are
becoming what you want
to be! B-believe... with
all of your freakin' heart!
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
集中精神...相信自己。
相信自己正在变成你想成为的样子！
相...相信...用你整颗心去相信啊！

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
*Phew* How's that?
Now do you see the
power of hope?
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
*Phew* 感觉怎么样？
现在见识到希望的力量了吧？

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
You want to become more
competent in your job? Um...
Alright, we can do that. Just
meditate with me, and we'll go
do some imagery work together.
I'm real good at this you know.
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
你想提升职业能力？
嗯...好吧，这个可以。
跟我一起冥想，我们来做点意象训练。
这可是我的拿手好戏。

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
J-just... visualize
yourself... being...
t-totally... awesome!
You've gotta see it, and
you've gotta feel it in your
freakin' heart and mind!
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
只...只要...想象自己...变得...超、超厉害！
你得看见那个自己，还得用心、用脑去感受啊！

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Yeap, it doesn't matter
if it's real or imagined...
Your mind will work on
whatever you feed it.
Placebos and psychosomatic symptoms-- it all ties together.
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
没错，不管是真的，还是想象出来的...
你给大脑什么信息，它就会朝那个方向运作。
安慰剂效应、心身症状——这些都是相通的。

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
What th--?! You sure
you don't want anything?
Hm, well, I think it's kind
of bad karma if I don't give
you anything in return, so...
Think of something. Quick.
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
什、什么？！
你确定什么都不要？
嗯，受了你的帮助却不给回报，我怕会遭报应，所以...
赶紧想个想要的东西吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Er, just use the medals
to further your manufacturing
research, and then you can
pay me back if your develop
something new. It's, um, like
an investment in your work!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
呃，拿这些奖牌继续你的制造研究吧，等研发出新东西，再报答我就好。
这就，嗯，算是对你研究的一笔投资！

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Yeah... Yeah.
Okay, I see where
you're coming from.
That's pretty smart.
Okay, I'll repay you when
we develop something new!
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
对...对。
好，我明白你的意思了。
真聪明。
那等我们研发出新东西，就报答你！

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Anyway, I need as many
medals as I can get as
soon as I can. How many
medals do you think you
can give me right now?
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
总之，我得尽快收集到尽可能多的奖牌。
你现在能给我多少枚？

scripts.text: Take them all.
scripts.translation: 全部给你

scripts.text: How about this much?
scripts.translation: 给这些怎么样

scripts.text: No, I changed my mind.
scripts.translation: 不了，我改主意了

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Th-thank you!
Thank you so much!
Your help will greatly
advance my research,
and I promise to repay
you as soon as I can!
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
谢、谢谢！
太感谢你了！
你的帮助会大大推进我的研究，我保证尽快报答你！

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Alright, please enter the
number of medals that
you're willing to give me.
Please don't enter any
number greater than 100.
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
好，请输入你愿意捐出的奖牌数量。
不要超过100枚。

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Aw, so you've decided
to cancel? Well, it's your
choice, but I'm still so
disappointed. Please come
back if you change your mind...
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
唉，你决定取消了？
好吧，这是你的选择，可我还是很失望。
如果改变主意了，请再来找我...

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Remember, you can only
enter a number from 1 to 100.
If you want to give me more
medals, then perhaps you
should just give them all to me~
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
记住，只能输入1到100之间的数字。
如果你想捐更多，不如直接全给我吧~

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
I'm sorry, but I don't
think you have that many
medals with you. Make sure
that you offer me an amount of
medals that you actually have.
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
抱歉，你身上好像没那么多奖牌。
请按实际拥有的数量来捐。

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Th-thank you!
Thank you so much!
Your help will greatly
advance my research,
and I promise to repay
you as soon as I can!
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
谢、谢谢！
太感谢你了！
你的帮助会大大推进我的研究，我保证尽快报答你！

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Oh, alright...
Still, I really need
those medals, so if you
change your mind, please
come back as soon as you can.
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
哦，好吧...

再次感谢你给了我那么多奖牌，想必收集起来很不容易。

scripts.text:
[Wayne]
Hold on a second...
If you want to exchange
your Prize Medals for items,
you'd better free up more space
in your Inventory first. Why don't you use your Kafra Storage?
scripts.translation:
[韦恩]
等一下...
想用神奇的奖牌兑换物品，得先在物品栏里腾出些空间。
要不先把一些东西存到卡普拉仓库？

scripts.text:
[Wayne]
Hello, there! Ever wonder
what you could do with all
the Prize Medals you can win
in Monster Race Arena? You
can donate them in Einbroch
to the Blacksmith Guild...
scripts.translation:
[韦恩]
你好！
想过魔物赛跑竞技场赢来的神奇的奖牌有什么用吗？
你可以把它们捐给艾音布罗克的铁匠公会...

scripts.text:
[Wayne]
...Or you can exchange them
for items, right here and right
now, with me. As always, the
choice is really up to you.
scripts.translation:
[韦恩]
...也可以现在就找我兑换物品。
当然，怎么选都由你决定。

scripts.text: Prize Medal Exchange
scripts.translation: 神奇的奖牌兑换

scripts.text: Cancel

scripts.text:

Well, just keep in mind
that you can always come
to me to trade in your Prize
Medals for consumable items.
That guy in Einbroch? Not sure
what he'd give you for them...
scripts.translation:
[韦恩]
记住，你随时都能来找我，用神奇的奖牌兑换消耗品。
至于艾音布罗克那个人会给你什么，我就不清楚了...

scripts.text:
[Wayne]
All I know is that he
needs a whole lot of medals
for the work that he's doing.
Still, I hear that he just may
make your donations worth
all your effort, you know?
scripts.translation:
[韦恩]
我只知道，他的研究需要大量奖牌。
不过，听说他给的回报，会让你觉得付出的努力都值得呢。

scripts.text:
[Eocatt]
There's an old, humble
village on the outskirts of
the Schwarzwald Republic.
It was just a tiny blip on the
map until they opened up
their Monster Race Arena!
scripts.translation:
[埃奥卡特]
修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国边境有个古老、朴素的小村庄。
以前它在地图上毫不起眼，直到魔物赛跑竞技场开张，才出了名！

scripts.text:
[Eocatt]
If you win wagers on the
monster race games, you'll
be rewarded with these Prize
Medals that are made of some
really rare metal. I hear this metal's in demand in Einbroch...
scripts.translation:
[埃奥卡特]
押中魔物赛跑的获胜魔物，就能得到神奇的奖牌。
这些奖牌是用一种非常稀有的金属做的，听说艾音布罗克很需要这种金属...

scripts.text:
[Eocatt]
Right, right...
I remember now, the
town was named Hugel.
I'm sure there's other fun
things to do there, but I'm sure that the Race Arena is a must!
scripts.translation:
[埃奥卡特]
对了，对了...
我想起来了，那地方叫毁葛。
那里应该还有别的好玩的，不过赛跑竞技场绝对不能错过！

scripts.text:
[Mudie]
The Monster Races
are probably the biggest
attraction here in Hugel.
We don't have much else
going on here, I'm afraid.
scripts.translation:
[穆迪]
魔物赛跑大概是毁葛最受欢迎的活动了。
我们这里恐怕也没多少别的热闹可看。

scripts.text:
[Mudie]
If you want to go visit
the Monster Race Arena,
just head towards the
7 'o clock direction on
your Mini-Map, and look for
the hill surrounded by a fence.
scripts.translation:
[穆迪]
想去魔物赛跑竞技场，就朝小地图的7点钟方向走，找一座围着栅栏的小山丘。

scripts.text:
[Mudie]
You should find the arena
somewhere around that area.
Anyway, if you want to wager
or just watch the races, just
ask one of the Eckar brothers. I hope you enjoy our little town~
scripts.translation:
[穆迪]
竞技场就在那一带。
想下注或只是看比赛，找埃卡尔兄弟中的任何一位都行。
希望你喜欢我们的小镇~

scripts.text:
[Eccentric Scholar]
Let's see now...
Monster 1's average speed
and luck, as affected by
wind resistance, fatigue...
What's the approximate
probability of winning...?
scripts.translation:
[古怪的学者]
让我看看...
1号魔物的平均速度、幸运值，再考虑风阻、疲劳的影响...
获胜的概率大概是多少...？

algorithm... Carry the two...

figures should I be using?
Ah, right, 7, to account for x,
a value representing--

代入我的算法...进2...
等等，该保留几位有效数字？
啊，对，7位，还得考虑x，这个值代表——

Now, where was I...?
scripts.translation:
[古怪的学者]
安、安静！
我必须算完！
刚才算到哪儿了...？

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Guildsman]
How many times must
I wager on these races?!
I haven't won even once!
Oh, I must have the worst
luck in wagering history!
scripts.translation:
[铁匠公会成员]
到底还要下多少次注啊？！
我一次都没赢过！
我一定是下注史上最倒霉的人！

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Guildsman]
I've been assigned by my
guild to bring back some
Prize Medals to Einbroch...
They're apparently made
with some rare metal, but...
It's too hard for me to win~!
scripts.translation:
[铁匠公会成员]
公会派我来，要我带些神奇的奖牌回艾音布罗克...
听说奖牌是用某种稀有金属做的，可是...
要赢到奖牌也太难了~！

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Guildsman]
Run! Go go go!
I need to win some
medals! Otherwise, I'll
be too ashamed to return
home to Einbroch! F-faster!
scripts.translation:
[铁匠公会成员]
跑啊！
快跑快跑！
我得赢些奖牌才行，不然哪有脸回艾音布罗克！
再、再快点！

scripts.text:
[Valiant Knight]
Hey, have you been
wagering on the races?
If you've got a hot tip, then
would you share it with me?
I've won some wagers... But
I really wanna win more!
scripts.translation:
[英勇的骑士]
嘿，你也在给比赛下注吗？
有什么可靠消息，能告诉我吗？
我已经赢了几次...不过，还想赢更多！

scripts.text:
[Valiant Knight]
Hah hah! It's like I tell
those Blacksmiths! If they
don't wanna lose all the time,
then they should just bet on the same monster. Me? I always
bet on the black Deviruchi~
scripts.translation:
[英勇的骑士]
Hah hah! 我早就跟那些铁匠说过！
不想一直输，就该一直押同一只魔物。
我？
我总是押黑色的小恶魔~

scripts.text:
[Valiant Knight]
You too...!
Always bet
on Deviruchi!
scripts.translation:
[英勇的骑士]
你也一样...！
就一直押小恶魔！

scripts.text:
[Familiar Drunkard]
Grrr...! ^333333*Hiccup*^000000
I just gotta win this
next game! I hafta do it!
Hey, you! Which number is
your lucky number? Huh?
scripts.translation:
[眼熟的酒鬼]
Grrr...! ^333333*Hiccup*^000000
下一场我一定得赢！
一定得赢！
嘿，你！
你的幸运数字是几？
啊？

scripts.text:

C'mon, I need your
lucky number cuz I ran
out of mine! Tell me!
Tell me! ^333333*Hiccup~*^000000

[眼熟的酒鬼]
快说，我的幸运数字都用光了，得借你的用用！
告诉我！
告诉我！^333333*Hiccup~*^000000

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Guildsman]
How can this be so hard?
Why can't I win at least
one of these races? Argh!
I can't go back until I get
at least one Prize Medal!
scripts.translation:
[铁匠公会成员]
怎么会这么难？
为什么我连一场都赢不了？
Argh! 不拿到至少一枚神奇的奖牌，我就不能回去！

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Guildsman]
Yeah, I've been assigned
by the Einbroch Factory to
get some Prize Medals since
they're made of this rare medal. But it looks like they picked
the wrong guy for this job...
scripts.translation:
[铁匠公会成员]
是啊，艾音布罗克工厂派我来收集神奇的奖牌，因为奖牌是用稀有金属做的。
可看来他们找错人了...

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Guildsman]
I mean, I've been here
forever and I haven't won
anything yet! Hey, do me
a favor and give any extra
Prize Medals you might have
to the Einbroch Factory, okay?
scripts.translation:
[铁匠公会成员]
我在这儿待了那么久，什么都没赢到！
嘿，帮个忙，如果你有多余的神奇的奖牌，就交给艾音布罗克工厂，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Absent Minded Man]
Say, are you here to bet
on the monster races? I've
come all the way here, just
because some strange man
asked me to win medals. It's
the only reason I'm in Hugel...
scripts.translation:
[心不在焉的男子]
你也是来给魔物赛跑下注的吗？
有个奇怪的男人叫我来赢奖牌，我才大老远跑到这里。
我来毁葛，就为了这件事...

scripts.text:
[Absent Minded Man]
But I've made more than
100 wagers, and haven't won
any of them! I mean, if I bet
on the same monster 6 times,
I should win at least once,
right? What's going on?!
scripts.translation:
[心不在焉的男子]
可我下了100多次注，一次都没赢！
同一只魔物押6次，怎么也该赢一次吧？
到底怎么回事？！
